capabilities: Highlight PDF and Markdown text in eight colors
Add in-context comments and free-position notes
Mark areas of PDF figures, tables and images
Search, filter, pin and edit annotations in a sidebar
Export annotations to Markdown in seven layouts
extras: Desktop only, minimum Obsidian 1.12.0. EPUB support is experimental and off by default. Annotations are stored in the plugin's data.json rather than in source documents, and exports are snapshots that never overwrite existing files.
motivation: Created for reading academic literature in Obsidian, to bring highlighting, annotation and research notes together without sacrificing reading space.
problem: Reading and annotating literature inside Obsidian splits highlighting, comments and research notes across separate tools instead of keeping them on the page.

relations.evidence: Zotlit can be used to open Zotero PDFs
Requires caronchen's ePub Reader (reference implementation v1.0.4).
Vittra may be used for translation alongside reading.

summary: Reading-first annotation tool that highlights and comments on PDFs and Markdown, with area highlights, floating toolbars and Markdown export.
